# Root Cause Analysis

Based on the context provided, **the Glance image service is the true root cause**. The constraint indicates that Glance image download errors are occurring (referenced as [img-e08748b4]), which is preventing proper image retrieval and likely cascading into nova-scheduler failures as a secondary effect.

**Recommendation:** Investigate and resolve the Glance image service download issues first, as this will eliminate the upstream dependency failure and resolve the nova-scheduler errors that are occurring as a consequence.
